regenerate: cd studio/04_audio_sfx_music/tools && python3 sfx.py && python3 music.py && python3 qa.py

reference.note: Gains below are applied to the files as delivered. Final master: sum, then normalise to -14 LUFS / -1 dBTP.

bed_cold_open.wav.note: 0-25 s; its hit lands at 23.3 s - align to the title/first-item cut. Duck under VO by 4 dB more during dense lines.

bed_main_loop.wav.note: Loop seamlessly (sample 0 follows last sample). Start it at a bar boundary (2.6667 s grid) on the first item cut.

bed_outro.wav.note: Crossfade from main loop over 1.5 s at the closing reframe.

ducking.note: Static gains above already sit ~16 LU under VO; ducking only handles phrase gaps (music swells back up 5 dB in pauses > 0.6 s).

music.eq: Beds already carry a -4 dB broad dip at 1.4 kHz (Q 0.45) to leave room for the voice. Do not add further low end below 40 Hz.

placement_rules: SFX hit on the frame the visual event happens (tile pops on its first visible frame, shatter on the crack frame).
Never more than one foreground SFX in any 250 ms window; ticks for label lists may run at 12/s only via counter_tick_loop.
Rotate variants (_1.._4) so no two consecutive identical events use the same file.
heat_rise ends hard: place its last sample 1-2 frames before glass_shatter; duck music -6 dB for the 1 s around a shatter.
Glass shatter is the signature moment of this video: keep VO silent for >= 0.4 s around it.
stamp_thud_* only for the red anchor stamp (once or twice per video), paired with a 2-frame scale punch.
sub_hit_* max 2 per video (cold-open title + final reveal).
water_spray_loop under VO only at -26 dB or lower; fade 300 ms in/out.
alarm_bell_distant only in the cold open/fire-context shots; never under item explanations.
